subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: What privacy and exposure contract should inbound WhatsApp call events use before they become visible to agents or plugin hooks?
rationale: The listener gap is source-proven, but deciding default-off behavior, metadata retention, access-control filtering, and agent/plugin visibility is a product and security boundary choice.

options.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
options.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing access-control checks.

options.title: Plugin hook only
options.body: Expose call events only through a documented plugin hook and defer agent session/tool behavior until a separate product decision.

options.title: Defer inbound calls
options.body: Leave this open until maintainers decide WhatsApp call metadata is worth the privacy and verification cost.

recommendation.title: Default-off sanitized plugin path
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp-owned opt-in listener that exposes only filtered call activity metadata after existing access-control checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently owned the related WhatsApp call feature and already commented with the product/security boundaries for this request.
